name: Staged: the RÅDMANSÖ king with a RÅDMANSÖ nightstand on each side, the RÅDMANSÖ 6-drawer dresser opposite on the left wall, HomePop's cognac 60in bench at the foot on Tumble's Olivia Ivory/Neutral 6x9 laid across the bed's lower third
notes:
Re-staged 2026-11-10 on Andrew's word, with a screenshot of an Amazon listing (a camel bench at the foot of a bed on a pale gray-ivory rug that runs under the bed's lower part): "I want an end of bed ottoman and a rug in the style here (i.e. coving a part of the end of the bed and the ottoman). Be mindful: radmanso drawers will be placed on the wall opposite the bed. show me layout in browser. Use amazon only for searches. Be a interior designer, make sure color,lenght etc work". The room as it was is l. 11 placed, 10 extras.
bed-1 RÅDMANSÖ king with the LURÖY base (floor): right wall, rot 90, x 89.625-177, y 30.25-109.375, unchanged. F-34: the window side 27 1/4" from the heater's face to the frame; the bathroom side 23 5/8" to the bottom wall, the walk to the bathroom (walkway-narrow:23.6, his word, F-31). Its foot stands on the rug's last 28 3/8".
nightstand-1, nightstand-2 RÅDMANSÖ (floor), night-light-1 TÖVÄDER (top), lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS (top), art-1 PJÄTTERYD (top): unchanged from l (F-64, F-31, F-33; the bathroom-side nightstand in the doorway's hinge corner at the sketch's door position, assumed-position:door).
dresser-1 RÅDMANSÖ 6-drawer dresser, brown walnut effect, 62 5/8 x 18 7/8 x 31 7/8" (floor): the left wall, opposite the king, rot 270, x 0-18.875, y 35-97.625, its center 3 1/2" off the bed's center line, so it reads centered from the bed while keeping 5 3/8" from the left door's swing (F-31, assumed-position:door). F-32: 50 3/4" from its drawer fronts to the bench (36" preferred), and its 9" drawers open over bare floor, 27 1/8" short of the rug's edge. F-33: 32" below the heater's face. The closet's landing (x 25-67) stays clear (assumed-position:closet). anchor-required (F-21: 31 7/8"; the page: "Designed to meet the US Federal Stability Standard"). Which RÅDMANSÖ dresser Andrew means isn't said: the 3-drawer (ikea-80593837, 35 3/8") or the 5-drawer (ikea-60593838, 27 1/2" x 52") would stand on the same line, the same 18 7/8" deep, so every clearance here holds.
bench-1 HomePop 60" Modern Storage Bench with Wood Legs, Cognac Brown Faux Leather, 60 x 18 x 21" (floor): across the foot, rot 90, x 69.625-87.625, y 39.8125-99.8125, centered on the bed and 2" off the footboard so the duvet hangs free, wholly on the rug. Length: 76% of the 79 1/8" frame, 9 9/16" in from each side (designers take 2/3 to 3/4 of the bed; his search was 60"). Height: 21" at the arms, 5 1/4" over the 15 3/4" footboard, a low line in front of the bed as in the photo. Color (F-68): the room is walnut, teal bedding and Sea Teal curtains on honey oak, so the bench is the warm note: cognac, a near complement to teal, a shade lighter than the walnut so it reads as its own piece; mid-century flared arms on splayed dark wood legs, the RÅDMANSÖ's own style (no orange-toned wood, F-68 (4)); faux leather wipes clean after Maddie and holds less dust than fabric (F-66, F-67). F-33: its upholstery 36 13/16" from the heater's face.
rug-1 Tumble Olivia Washable Area Rug, Ivory/Neutral, 6x9 (rug): rot 0, x 46-118, y 15.8125-123.8125, laid the photo's way: across the bed, under its lower 28 3/8" (a third of its 87 3/8"), 43 5/8" past the foot, so the bench stands on it with 23 5/8" of rug in front for the feet; 14 7/16" out past each side of the frame; the nightstands stay off it. F-33: 12 13/16" off the heater's face; 9 3/16" off the bottom wall. Size: from the window wall to the bottom wall the room is 133", so a rug across the bed can be 108" at most with F-33's 12" kept; an 8x10 turned across would come 6 13/16" from the heater's face and 3 3/16" from the bottom wall, and turned along (l's way) it shows 8" past each side and runs 70" under the bed, the other style. Color (F-68 (1)): a pale field under the dark walnut; Tumble calls its ground cool ivory that "casts as a very light grey in certain lighting", with taupe, khaki and brown accents: the photo's tone, cool beside the teal, its browns tying the walnut and the cognac together. Two-piece (F-69): a 1/8" cover on Tumble's 1/4" pad, both included; no robot vacuum at its edges.
plant-1 FEJKA areca palm (floor): unchanged, x 1.5-6.25, y 15-19.75, in the window-side corner 12" off the heater's face, 15 1/4" above the dresser.
Walkways (F-30): from the door, up between the dresser's fronts and the bench, 50 3/4", then 36 13/16" between the bench's top end and the heater's face to the bed's window side (27 1/4", F-34); from the door to the bathroom along the bottom of the room, 33 3/16" below the bench's lower end, then the bed's bathroom side, 23 5/8" (walkway-narrow:23.6). The closet's 36" landing stays clear (F-31).
Extras (unchanged from l): the Zinus Green Tea 12" king x1, DVALA King sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE King insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA King cover set x1, VILDKORN Queen pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, LEMOMO Sea Teal blackout pair x1 on the rod already up (F-43), PURRPINGLA laundry bag x1 in the walk-in closet. The bedding is to go teal, green and blue (F-68 (9)); the oatmeal ÄNGSLILJA stays listed until it is chosen.
Not placed: the BESTÅ column (the RÅDMANSÖ dresser takes the left wall; l keeps it); the pine PERJOHAN bench (the orange wood F-68 (4) questions; l keeps it); Tumble's Sophia 8x10 (l); the ottoman alternatives, HULALA HOME's 59" in Golden (amazon-B0HFNQ1YN7, track arms like the photo, fabric) and the screenshot's own 53" Camel (amazon-B0HP9L4NDH, short for a king); the RÅDMANSÖ 3- and 5-drawer dressers (above).
Total $2,362.86: placed $1,671.72 + extras $691.14; prices as of 2026-10-22 to 2026-11-10 (those before 2026-11-10 price-stale, F-02).
Flags across the layout: walkway-narrow:23.6 (the bed's bathroom side), assumed-position:door (the dresser 5 3/8" from the left door's swing; nightstand-2 in the bathroom doorway's corner), assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, anchor-required (dresser-1).
Move-in checks (F-07, F-64): as in l (the right wall's 133", the bathroom door's distance from the corner), and the left door: if it starts more than 5 3/8" up from the bottom-left corner, slide the dresser toward the window by the difference (it has 26" to F-33's 6" line), and the bench and rug stay.
